Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Recap and next steps — Redwood pilot

Jordan — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Problem you want solved: reduce inference cost for chat + maintain 99th pctl latency < 120ms for the internal agent workflow.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data, strict retention policy (30 days), VPC-only for production.
- Success metrics for pilot: 50% token-cost reduction vs current baseline, average latency under 150ms for interactive flows, and qualitative pass on answer consistency for 3 sample prompts.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive (SRE + model ops) to validate KV cache approach and network egress — 60–90m. Options: Tue 24th 10am PT or Wed 25th 2pm PT.
2) Share pilot scope & integration checklist (attached) so your infra team can pre-check networking and KMS requirements.
3) Statement of work draft and timeline (we can prepare a short SOW once we confirm sequencing).

Attachments: Finera-Integration-Checklist.pdf, Pilot-scope-v1.xlsx

If either of the proposed times works, I’ll send an invite and loop in Marissa for the SRE/solutions details. If now isn’t the right time, tell me what timeline you’d prefer and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
